description: A modern three-seater sofa with a low profile and sleek metal legs. The upholstery is a rich, warm brown, possibly leather or a high-quality faux leather, giving it a sophisticated and comfortable appearance. It features three plush seat cushions and three back cushions, arranged neatly. Two throw pillows are placed on the left side of the sofa: one with a bold black and white zebra pattern and another plain white pillow. A patterned throw blanket, with yellow and grey geometric shapes, is draped over the right armrest, adding a touch of texture and color. The overall design suggests contemporary living room furniture, emphasizing comfort and style.
